text:
maria: Hey team — noticed dashboard annotations are misaligned for the last few quantization CI runs. annotations from run A show up on run B's diff panel :confused:

jon: ugh. which viz? scorecard or diffpanel?

maria: diffpanel + the per-sample drilldown. counts look right but the annotations (labels like "regression: hallucination") are attached to different sample rows.

sophia: I think this started after we changed the runner to dedupe runs by commit hash rather than eval_run_id.

tomer: can you paste a quick example of run ids?

maria: sure — from recent CI:
```
eval_run_id: 2026-03-15-xyz (quantized)
commit_hash: a1b2c3d
dashboard_run_key: a1b2c3d-20260315
```
and a different job had eval_run_id: 2026-03-15-xyz-2 but same commit_hash. dashboard shows both under one header and annotations mix.

jon: looks like front-end groups by dashboard_run_key which is commit-based. backend ingestion uses eval_run_id for per-sample annotations. mismatch when frontend groups.

sophia: quick fix options: 1) change UI grouping to use eval_run_id when present 2) adjust ingestion to set dashboard_run_key to canonical eval_run_id 3) store mapping in telemetry and rehydrate on frontend.

maria: minimal change is (2) on ingestion: set dashboard_run_key = eval_run_id if eval_run_id exists. but that may create a lot of new groupings in dashboard history.

tomer: agree on (2) but we need to keep back-compat for older runs. maybe fallback: dashboard_run_key = eval_run_id || commit_hash.

jon: also need a CI test so this doesn't regress. I propose a unit test in runner-ingest that simulates two jobs with same commit_hash but different eval_run_id and asserts annotations map only to their eval_run_id group.

maria: I'll open a PR. patch plan:
- runner/ingest: set dashboard_run_key during metadata enrichment
- api/dashboard: accept both keys but prefer eval_run_id when resolving drilldown queries
- frontend: minor change to prefer eval_run_id if present (defensive)
- add runner-ingest unit test and an e2e smoke test in ci-evals that uploads annotations and checks drilldown mapping

sophia: add a migration to reindex the last 7 days? customers will notice historic duplicates.

maria: good call. migration plan: reindex recent runs by querying samples where dashboard_run_key != eval_run_id and rewrite to eval_run_id grouping. small batch job.

jon: FYI I hit a related flake — eval-bot reported duplicate upload events earlier today:
```
[eval-bot] WARN: duplicate-annotation-detected run=2026-03-15-xyz file=annotations.ndjson
```
could be contributing.

eval-bot: automatic notice — duplicate detection threshold raised from 3->5 for today due to noisy replays.

tomer: let's treat the duplicate uploads separately, but fix grouping now.

maria: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/runner/pull/482 — includes ingestion change + unit test. requesting review from @jon and @sophia.

jon: looking now. quick note: update metrics names so we can alert if annotation-mismatch-rate > 0.5% after rollout.

sophia: logging tip: include both eval_run_id and dashboard_run_key in metric tags so we can graph mismatches.

maria: deployed ingest patch to staging. running new e2e.

jon: staging smoke passed for 3/3 runs. one more edge-case: multi-step evals where eval_run_id is stable but commit_hash changes (rerun on different CI). need to prefer eval_run_id still.

maria: agreed. final note — will schedule reindex job during tomorrow's maintenance window and add a dashboard tile to surface any leftover mismatches for 48h post-migration. :thumbsup:

sophia: sounds good. thanks for moving fast!

maria: np — will post PR link to release notes when merged.
